omarchy-settings-dev on Omarchy

The same Omarchy defaults package, built straight from the bleeding-edge quattro branch.

Generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install omarchy-settings-dev on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings-dev. It is a 1.7 MB download (9.4 MB installed), version 4.0.0.r7195.g3ac4365-1, licensed MIT. Omarchy user defaults, /etc/skel content, fonts, plymouth theme, and support helpers (quattro branch tip). Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install omarchy-settings-dev on Omarchy

This is a development build of omarchy-settings, pulling its defaults (skel files, fonts, Plymouth theme, helper scripts) from the tip of Omarchy's in-progress 'quattro' branch rather than a stable release. It exists so testers and contributors can run tomorrow's Omarchy defaults today, ahead of them landing in the main package.

The official repository lists this package in Themes & Desktop. It was added on 2026-06-03.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings-dev
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 4.0.0.r7195.g3ac4365-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-settings-dev

Open and use omarchy-settings-dev

omarchy-settings-dev has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql omarchy-settings-dev | grep /usr/bin/

omarchy-settings-dev requirements and compatibility

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-settings-dev on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings-dev. The download is 1.7 MB and it takes 9.4 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-settings-dev free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-settings-dev?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-settings-dev. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-settings-dev depend on?

The package declares 6 dependencies: bash, curl, gum, sudo, hicolor-icon-theme, plymouth. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-settings-dev a desktop app?

No. omarchy-settings-dev has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is omarchy-settings-dev in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-settings-dev (version 4.0.0.r7195.g3ac4365-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom/omarchy.
